extracted.name: California Farm Chili Relleno
extracted.description: Look, mama, no slits in the peppers that spill cheese! Three poblano peppers, blistered over an open gas flame, then the stems hollowed out on top, seeds removed, four french fry size mozarella sticks pushed inside each, stem plug back on, rolled in beaten egg and flour, pan fried in olive oil two minutes on each side, dinner is served.
ingredient_lines: 4 french fry size mozarella sticks per pepper
Tbs all purpose flour per pepper
Olive oil to coat the frying pan
instruction_lines: Grill the washed poblano peppers over open gas flame till the skin blisters. Remove blisters, usually rubs right off between fingers.
With sharp knife, cut around the stem and pull seedpod out. Rub seeds off, push four mozarella sticks inside each pepper, push stem back in.
Roll peppers twice in beaten egg, flour, beaten egg, flour. Medium heat skillet, bottom of olive oil, fry peppers two minutes on each side. Usually three sides per pepper..
Mexican Sour cream or greek yoghurt on top, serve! Enjoy.
